front.title: Registries of Network File System Version 4 Protocol Elements

abstract.t: Several numbered NFS version 4 protocol elements, among them operations, callback operations, status codes, file attributes, and the flags of the ACCESS and OPEN operations, are identified by values that no IANA registry records, so protocol extensions under development at the same time can assign the same value to different elements. This document requests an IANA registry for each of these element types, populates the registries from published RFCs, and requires future elements to obtain their values through them. It updates RFC 8178.
